item.title: Galway county house prices up 14.8% in 12 months survey finds
item.description: The price of the average second-hand three-bed semi in County Galway rose to €310,000 in 2025, up 14.8% from €270,000 at the end of 2024, according to a national survey by Real Estate Alliance.
